responseMessageContents.text: The user is saying the preview looks the same - they're referring to a previous change that doesn't seem to have taken effect. Let me check the recent history to understand what was last changed.
Let me check what the last change was about and review the current state of the files.

The previous change was to the PDF export content (the HTML generated when you tap the export button). It wouldn't change how the profile **screen** looks — it only affects the exported PDF document. The profile screen UI itself was not modified.

Was there a specific visual change you wanted to see on the profile screen, or were you expecting the PDF export to look different when you actually export it?
